entries.name: Hasvet PG International Animal Hospital
entries.note: Own page: 'Dostupni smo 24/7 sa našim hitnim veterinarskim uslugama u vanrednim situacijama.' No regular hours listed. CG Stray emergency guide also calls it the only 24h vet clinic in Montenegro (their claim, not used as basis). Phones +382 68 119 100 and +382 20 801 843 on own page.

entries.name: Montvet veterinarska ambulanta
entries.note: Own contact page: phones 067/229-876, 020/662-578, 069/361-461, 020/662-584; emergency line 069/190-488 ('Za hitne intervencije') with no hours. No 24h claim on own page (CG Stray page says '24h duty vet for emergency calls' - not confirmed by clinic, so false).

notes: No official Montenegrin register with phones/hours was readable: gov.me pages of the Uprava za bezbjednost hrane, veterinu i fitosanitarne poslove only expose document titles (the clinic list is a 19 MB docx without an accessible link), and no Veterinarska komora Crne Gore page was found. No duty rota (dežurstvo) and no animal poison line found for Montenegro. Only Hasvet (Podgorica) states 24/7. The WebFetch tool could only open URLs that appeared in earlier results, and animavet.me forbids automated access (robots), canis.me loops on redirect and vetport.me failed to load, so these clinics rely on the CG Stray / Kotor Kitties NGO pages. Left to do: Budva and Kotor additional clinics, Nikšić others, Bijelo Polje, Pljevlja, Kolašin/Žabljak, Berane, Danilovgrad, Rožaje, Bar/Ulcinj others (only planplus.rs aggregator listings found, not used); Univerzitet Crne Gore has no veterinary faculty hospital; clinic own sites for Adria Vet, Vet Medica, Novi Vet, PetVet, MedicusVet (Instagram/Facebook only).
